invite.subject: {inviterName} invited you to {familyName} on {appName}
invite.text:
{inviterName} added you to {familyName} on {appName}, the app your family uses for tasks, shared expenses, notices and SOS alerts.

Your family invite code is: {inviteCode}

To join:
1. Install the {appName} app.
2. Create an account with this email address ({email}), or sign in if you already have one.
3. Choose "Join a family" and enter the invite code.

Using this email address links you to the profile {inviterName} created for you.

Keep this code within your family: anyone who has it can ask to join. If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

errors.guardianConsentRequired: This member is younger than {age}. A parent or guardian must confirm consent before the profile can be saved.
errors.countryConsentRequired: Some members are younger than {age}, the consent age in the new country. Confirm guardian consent for them first, then change the country.
errors.selfEditLimited: You can only change your own name, phone number, photo, gender and date of birth. Ask a family admin for anything else.
errors.accountEmailLocked: This member signs in with this email address, so it cannot be changed here.
errors.memberLimitReached: A family can have at most {limit} members. Remove a profile you no longer need to add someone new.
errors.verifyEmailToLink: Verify your email address first. Your family already created a profile for this address, and it can only be linked to a verified account.
